setting.herobot.allow_listing_bot_player: Allows listing bot players on the multiplayer screen
setting.herobot.allow_spawning_offline_p: Spawn offline players in online mode if online-mode player with specified name does not exist
setting.herobot.bot_leave_on_death.toolt: Bots disconnect on death rather than respawning
setting.herobot.bot_ping_to_ticks.toolti: Change the ping to tick conversion for Bot Players (default 25)
setting.herobot.clients_ignore_slow_tick: If true, makes client players ignore slower tick rates
setting.herobot.creative_fly_drag.toolti: Changes creative air drag (Default 0.09), how quickly the air stops the client while flying
setting.herobot.creative_fly_speed.toolt: Changes creative flying speed multiplier (Default 1.0), how quickly the client flies
setting.herobot.creative_no_clip.tooltip: Creative No Clip, allows to client player to phase through blocks
setting.herobot.damage_ticks.tooltip: Change how many ticks the hurt animation/red flash and damage cooldown last when any living entity is damaged (default 10)
setting.herobot.delete_chunk_entities.to: Chunk Resetting deletes entities within that chunk
setting.herobot.disable_experimental_scr: Remove the experimental world setting (if on client disables all, if on world, only disables it on this world)
setting.herobot.editable_player_nbt.tool: Enables editing player nbt, so you can directly edit values within a player's data
setting.herobot.explosion_no_fire.toolti: Allows intentional game design explosions (from beds and respawn anchors) to not explode with fire
setting.herobot.kb_scaling.tooltip: Disable knockback scaling, as in entities will take the same vertical knockback regardless of their previous vertical velocity
setting.herobot.no_projectile_random.too: Removes randomness from projectiles while true
setting.herobot.shield_delay_ticks.toolt: Change the delay of bringing up the shield
setting.herobot.shield_stunning.tooltip: Enables shield stunning, where the shielding player can be damaged immediately after the shield is disabled
setting.herobot.shield_stunning_window.t: Makes shield stuns use decreased [paper] kb during the window, default 5
setting.herobot.wind_charge_no_trigger.t: Wind Charges won't activate redstone blocks
setting.herobot.xp_no_cooldown.tooltip: Players absorb XP instantly, without delay
